proposals.name: The Illuminators
proposals.why: Each guardian lights one page of a single book by hand, as the Georgian illuminators did, so every design leaves the panel with its initials painted and its margins warm.

proposals.name: Once Upon a Panel
proposals.why: The app is a story with a beginning and an ending, and every design we judge is one panel of it, so the name opens like a tale and turns like a page.

proposals.name: The Lamplit Scriptorium
proposals.why: Many hands work through the night under one warm lamp, which is where Medea's craft, the Moon's quiet and ink on paper meet, so the panel reads as a single room of scribes.
